title: arctostaphylos glandulosa subsp. howellii
intro: Arctostaphylos glandulosa subsp. howellii, commonly known as Howell's manzanita, is a subspecies of the manzanita plant, a type of evergreen shrub native to California in the United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Howell's manzanita include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
